name: Le Taha'a Island Resort & Spa
insider_take: The only resort on sacred Taha'a island, where vanilla orchids perfume the air and Mount Ohiri's mystical peaks rise from crystalline lagoons.
whats_special: This exclusive Relais & Châteaux property sits on a private motu (coral islet) facing the "Vanilla Island" of Taha'a, where 80% of French Polynesia's prized vanilla is cultivated. The resort's overwater suites offer direct views of Bora Bora's iconic silhouette, while the island's coral gardens remain among the Pacific's most pristine diving sites.
pro_tip: Book the vanilla tour during flowering season (November-January) when the orchids bloom and you can witness hand-pollination techniques passed down through generations of Tahitian farmers.
dont_miss: The sunset ritual at Ohiri Bar, where traditional Polynesian drums echo across the lagoon as the sun disappears behind Bora Bora's volcanic peaks. The resort's signature Taha'a vanilla-infused spa treatments use locally sourced vanilla beans harvested just minutes away by outrigger canoe.
pros: Stunning overwater bungalows with direct lagoon access
World-class spa featuring traditional Polynesian treatments
Breathtaking views of Bora Bora and pristine coral reef
